categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 研究集中在3D场景表示、LLM推理与可解释理论、Agent自我改进与注入防护、AI辅助科学发现。

articles.title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
articles.zh: Honeycomb-Surfels：用于高效场景渲染与重建的紧凑六边形图元
articles.summary: 如果你在做3DGS或神经渲染，正为场景表示的内存和速度发愁，这套六边形图元的打包思路值得拿来跟自己的高斯方案对照一下。
articles.author: Prakhar Kaushik, Soumava Paul 等
articles.body: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.
articles.bodyZh: 新视角合成（novel view synthesis）和三维重建（3D reconstruction）靠着辐射场（radiance fields）和泼溅（splatting）发展得飞快，但它们太吃内存、太吃算力，在资源受限的场景里就很难用。我们提出了 Hexels：一种全新的平面六边形表面单元（planar hexagonal surface elements），带一阶空间颜色场（first-order spatial color field），能高效表示三维场景和二维图像。Hexels 利用局部近似平面的区域，外观变化平滑，所以用更少、更大的基元（primitives）就能搞定。它的六边形支撑区域在面积和边界上都更高效，而局部颜色场能抓住每个基元内部的外观变化。在 34 个场景上，Hexels 在多个数据集上把峰值信噪比（PSNR）比内存匹配的 2DGS 提高了 4.53 到 7.38 dB，同时训练用的显存（VRAM）更低。我们还做了消融实验（ablation），结果表明：按每个基元来比，Hexels 比 2DGS 最高提升 4.74 dB，训练显存更低，帧率（FPS）还快 2.31 倍。即使在不受限制的设置下，Hexels 也能提供互补的质量-内存权衡。为了高效重建三维表面，在 15 个 DTU 扫描（DTU scans）上，Hexels 把误差比内存匹配的 2DGS 降低了 28.9%。在 6 个 Tanks and Temples 表面场景上，Hexels 在所有对比方法里拿到最高的平均 F1 分数（F1）（34.38%，2DGS 是 31.72%）。我们还展示了，Hexels 作为一种通用基元，在二维图像表示上比 Image-GS 更好。Hexels 把表面对齐基元（surface-aligned primitives）在质量-效率权衡上的帕累托前沿（Pareto frontier）往前推了一步。

articles.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
articles.zh: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化“动力学链”推理
articles.summary: 如果你关心LLM怎么做物理和动力学推理，这篇把“先想象世界状态”塞进推理链，思路可以直接搬到具身和仿真任务上试。
articles.author: Chaehyun Kim, Chi-Pin Huang 等
articles.body: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
articles.bodyZh: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型在机器人操作（robotic manipulation）上已经进步很大，但它们的泛化能力（generalization）还是受限于带动作标签的机器人演示（action-labeled robot demonstrations）够不够多样、覆盖够不够广。人类视频能提供更广的行为和环境经验，可要拿它们来学习，就绕不开一个根本矛盾：一边是可规模化的数据（scalable data），另一边是明确动作依据（explicit action grounding）。我们提出 ThinkWorld，一个 VLA 学习框架，把动作推理（action reasoning）建立在世界动态（world dynamics）上，再通过结合世界想象（world imagination）的强化学习（reinforcement learning）来加强。ThinkWorld 把每个动作想法表示成一条“动态链”（Chain-of-Dynamics，CoD），也就是一串离散的运动标记（discrete motion tokens），它抓住从当前世界到未来状态之间的中间动态，并作为一种跨不同本体（embodiments）通用的动作表示。我们先拿带动作标签的演示来初始化 CoD，然后预测每条 CoD 会引出什么样的未来，并强化那些预测结果更贴合实际观察结果的 CoD。这样一来，没有动作标注（action annotations）的视频也能靠观察到的状态转移（state transitions）提供直接监督，让人类和机器人的经验去打磨同一个推理空间。仿真（simulation）和真实机器人上的实验都表明，人到机器人的迁移（human-to-robot transfer）很有效，对没见过的任务和环境也有很强的泛化能力。

articles.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
articles.zh: 安全注意力头：可学习的注意力门控提升提示注入鲁棒性
articles.summary: 如果你在给Agent加防护，这篇说不用外挂过滤器、改几个注意力门控就够，但要留意它对正常指令跟随的削弱。
articles.author: Igor Shilov, Xiaoxue Yang 等
articles.body: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.
articles.bodyZh:
我们推出一个叫 Heads of Security（简称 HoS）的提示注入防御（prompt injection defense）方法。它靠一小套可学习的、按注意力头分别训练的门控（per-head attention gates），把“指令”和“数据”硬分开（instruction-data separation）。HoS 会学习每个注意力头该怎么在可信词元（token）和不可信词元之间重新分配注意力，让模型能对不可信内容做推理，但不会跟着里面夹带的指令走。

我们在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 和 GPT-OSS-20B 上评估了 HoS。我们拿它和 SecAlign++ 比——后者是基于微调的最先进防御；也和 ASIDE 比——ASIDE 跟我们思路类似，是把指令-数据分离做进模型架构里的防御。

结果显示，HoS 对自适应攻击（adaptive attacks）更抗打，在标准效用基准（utility benchmarks）上表现更好，在标准的智能体提示注入基准（agentic prompt injection benchmarks）上也能达到顶尖水平。更具体地说，黑盒（black-box）的 RL-Hammer 攻击对 GPT-OSS-20B 的攻击成功率（ASR）能到 97%，对 SecAlign 能到 85%，但打 HoS 只有 10%。Claudini 是一种最先进的白盒攻击（white-box attack），通过自动研究（autoresearch）针对 HoS 做了加强；结果它要在 HoS 上达到和打 GPT-OSS-20B 或 SecAlign 一样的攻击成功率，需要多花 3 倍的浮点运算量（FLOPs）。HoS 在标准多选题基准和各种提示设置下能保住基座模型（base model）的效用，而 SecAlign 和 ASIDE 在少样本（few-shot）设置下会掉性能。

在带静态攻击（static attacks）的智能体基准（agentic benchmarks）上，HoS 和 SecAlign 表现差不多，而且相比基座模型，明显把安全性和可用性的平衡做得更好。ASIDE 在工具使用（tool use）上很吃力，效用只有 10%。这些结果说明，提示注入的鲁棒性（robustness）是可以通过有针对性的注意力干预（targeted attention interventions）做到并继续提升的。

articles.title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
articles.zh: 注意力即格点规范场论：关系只能通过Wilson环相互作用
articles.summary: 如果你对Transformer可解释性的数学框架感兴趣，这篇给了一个带物理味的重构视角，但离工程落地还相当远。
articles.author: Aakash Sarkar, Ananya Mukherjee 等
articles.body: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy $H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is $U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$ with $Ψ$ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved $S_4$ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.
articles.bodyZh: 关系是通过它们共同连着的那个实体串起来的——Alice 是 Bob 的妈妈，Bob 是 Carol 的爸爸，所以 Alice 就是 Carol 的奶奶——而且顺序很重要，因为“爸爸的妈妈”不是“妈妈的爸爸”；验证一个复合关系，就是把这条链首尾对上、把圈闭合。我们证明：如果每个实体自己的坐标框架都能独立旋转（per-entity frame freedom，逐实体框架自由度），就会有三件事成立。第一，在纯规范扇区（pure-gauge sector）里，不共用任何环路的关系完全不能互相影响。第二，一个三角形唯一规范不变的评分（gauge-invariant score），是它的和乐（holonomy）H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki} 的类函数（class function）——也就是一个威尔逊环（Wilson loop）。第三，一条边唯一能做的等变更新（equivariant update）是 U = Ψ(H) T_{ij}，其中 Ψ 要满足共轭等变（conjugation-equivariant）。所以，用威尔逊环做边注意力，不是众多设计方案里的一个，而是对称性允许的唯一形式。现在有三个圈子各拿着这种形式的一部分：知识图谱里的交换算子嵌入（commuting-operator embeddings）对应它的阿贝尔（交换）扇区；AlphaFold 的三角形更新和 Edge Transformer 有它的外形——通过第三个顶点来更新一条边——但没有它的约束；格点量子色动力学（lattice QCD）则在格点上用等变方式把它搭出来。我们把这个等变子族落到一般关系图上，做成和乐注意力（holonomy attention）。它完全不用训练，只靠复合，就能在稀疏图上、五分之一的边被破坏时，以 0.88 的水平推断出没观测到的 S₄ 关系，跟专门的同步算法持平或略低；而所有可交换架构的上限只有 0.083。它的和乐分数识别被破坏三角形的 AUC 能到 0.99，而交换分数被第二条选择规则卡在 0.76；它还能在没标签的情况下把簇分开。

articles.title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
articles.zh: KPPax：面向大气化学机器学习的可微动力学ODE预处理工具
articles.summary: 如果你想把ML接进大气化学或气候模型，这个可微化学求解器能替你省掉重造轮子的功夫。
articles.author: Wenqing Peng, Michael Boy 等
articles.body: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. In the first, the Fisher information matrix computed from an automatically differentiated Jacobian predicts, before any fit, which of the 25 rate coefficients a flow-tube-like design can identify, and noisy synthetic estimation confirms the predicted uncertainties of the nine identifiable rate coefficients to within about 30\% while revealing clusters of fast reactions of which only ratios are constrained. In the second, a neural-network correction of an emission inventory is trained offline on per-scenario 4D-Var retrievals and then fine-tuned online through the chemical model, which reduces the error of the biogenic correction by a factor of 2.4--5 and recovers information on low-temperature emissions that the individual retrievals lose. KPPax makes KPP mechanisms directly usable for parameter estimation and hybrid physics--machine-learning modelling.
articles.bodyZh: 大气化学机制（atmospheric chemical mechanisms）通常是用动力学预处理器（Kinetic PreProcessor，KPP）这套语言来发布的；这套工具能生成高效的 Fortran 或 C 代码，但没法直接塞进机器学习模型常用的可微分编程框架（differentiable programming frameworks）里。我们推出 KPPax，这是一个动力学预处理器：它能把用 KPP 语言写好的机制，生成 JAX 里可微分、即时编译（just-in-time compiled）、还能向量化（vectorisable）的化学代码。KPPax 在对数空间（log space）里用稀疏运算（sparse operations）来算速率定律（rate law），这样仍然保持可微分；对刚性系统（stiff system），它用 diffrax 库里的隐式求解器（implicit solvers）和正向、反向模式伴随（forward- and reverse-mode adjoints）来做积分，所以不用手写伴随代码，也能拿到精确的敏感度（sensitivities）。我们拿 POLLU 基准机制（benchmark mechanism）演示了两个应用。第一个应用里，我们用自动微分算出的雅可比矩阵（Jacobian）来算费舍尔信息矩阵（Fisher information matrix）；在任何拟合之前，它就能预测：一个类似流管的设计（flow-tube-like design）能从 25 个速率系数（rate coefficients）里识别出哪几个。带噪声的合成估计（noisy synthetic estimation）也验证了：9 个可识别速率系数的预测不确定度（uncertainties）能对到大约 30% 以内，同时还揭示出一些成簇的快速反应，而这些反应只能约束它们的比值。第二个应用里，我们给排放清单（emission inventory）做一个神经网络修正；先拿每个情景（per-scenario）的四维变分（4D-Var）反演（retrievals）结果离线训练，再通过化学模型在线微调（fine-tuned）。结果把生物源修正（biogenic correction）的误差缩小到原来的 1/2.4 到 1/5，还找回了单次反演会丢掉的低温排放（low-temperature emissions）信息。KPPax 让 KPP 机制能直接拿来搞参数估计（parameter estimation），也能用于物理与机器学习混合建模（hybrid physics–machine-learning modelling）。

articles.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
articles.zh: GEPA-Curator：面向自我改进Agent的精选式学习
articles.summary: 如果你在搭能自我迭代的Agent，这篇讲的是“怎么挑数据喂自己”而不是“怎么改模型”，重点是别让自我进化越练越偏。
articles.author: Zack Yu, Nicholas Lee 等
articles.body: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）现在越来越多地用在多轮智能体工作负载（multi-turn agentic workloads）里，这类任务得跟复杂环境持续互动。像 GEPA 这种现有的反思式提示优化器（reflective prompt optimizers），会从失败的执行过程（failed rollouts）里学习，但智能体失败不一定都是提示词的问题，也可能是运行框架有限制（harness limitations）、执行本身有随机性（stochastic execution），或者评估器判断有噪声（noisy judges）。我们认为，这类失败未必能给出有用的学习信号（learning signal），甚至可能帮倒忙；所以，得先挑一挑哪些任务该交给提示优化器，才能把效果做得更好。为此我们提出 GEPA-Curator，一个给提示优化器加“筛选和补料”的框架，用来决定哪些智能体经验应该参与提示优化。具体来说，GEPA-Curator 有两块：一是任务筛选（task curation），把那些很可能带来噪声、或者学习信号不可靠的任务过滤掉；二是历史成功轨迹检索（prior success retrieval），针对某个任务有选择地找回过去成功的执行轨迹（trajectories），把它们作为额外上下文喂给提示优化器。我们在 GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld 和 τ-bench 上评估了 GEPA-Curator，优化器模型（optimizer models）分别用了 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Opus 5。结果 GEPA-Curator 的平均表现达到或超过了两个基线（baselines），相比 GEPA 最高提升 20.7%，相比 ACE 最高提升 21.2%。

articles.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
articles.zh: LLM能否通过自由探索发现隐藏的物理定律？
articles.summary: 如果你正准备吹“AI做科学发现”，这篇实测会先告诉你自由探索到底能走到哪一步、又卡在哪里。
articles.author: Zhen Yang, Wen Wang 等
articles.body: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
articles.bodyZh: 科学发现常常始于一个意外的观察，而这个观察会引出一个新的研究问题。假如在一个物理规律被改过的世界里，大语言模型（LLMs）能不能注意到反常现象，比如更重的物体反而掉得更慢，并且在没人告诉它该查什么的情况下，通过做实验把这套规律找出来？为了评估这种能力，我们推出了 LongChang，一个自动化框架（automated framework），它能造出物理规律被改过的模拟世界（simulated worlds），里面有一条或多条规律跟普通物理不一样。被测试的 LLM 会像探索者一样行动，自己动手摆弄物体、做工具，去研究自己提出的问题，既没有指定研究任务，也没有关于这些规律的提示。另外还有一些独立的 LLM 智能体（agents），负责生成和审查场景、审查工具设计，并根据被改过的物理规律和探索记录，评估报告对不对、有没有实验支持。这些记录会引导场景继续演化，支持进一步探索，让整个循环不用人类插手也能跑起来。在 12 个 LLM 里，GPT-6-Astra 的发现率（discovery rate）达到 16.7%，其余 11 个都是 0%。探索记录显示，有些异常现象（anomalies）根本没被调查，而且对 altered physical laws 也只识别出了一部分。

articles.title: MuonGS: Pretraining LLMs with Relaxed Weight-Norm Control
articles.zh: MuonGS：用松弛权重范数控制预训练LLM
articles.summary: 如果你在预训练或复现优化器技巧，这篇把Muon类方法的权重范数约束放松了一点，属于可以直接抄进配置的超参细节。
articles.author: Athanasios Glentis, Dawei Li 等
articles.body: Weight decay and explicit weight-norm constraints improve optimizer performance in language model pretraining, yet a unified understanding of why such control helps and how much is needed remains incomplete. We analyze norm control in Muon over the entire training trajectory using the \emph{accumulated effective learning rate}, $C_T=\sum_{t<T}η_t/\|W_t\|_F$, where $η_t$ is the nominal learning rate and $η_t/\|W_t\|_F$ is the effective learning rate relative to the weight norm. For bounded update directions, accumulation over any training interval bounds relative weight displacement. We show that vanilla Muon can accumulate only logarithmically, potentially limiting exploration and helping explain its slower empirical progress, whereas MuonW and MuonH guarantee at least linear accumulation under the stated conditions. Going beyond bounded-norm control, we show that sufficiently slow norm growth guarantees faster accumulation than the logarithmic worst case, opening up less restrictive optimizer designs. Based on this insight, we propose MuonGS, which uses Gram--Schmidt (GS) projection to remove the radial component of each Muon update without fixing the weight norm. With bounded update directions and a constant nominal learning rate, we prove that the weight norm grows at most proportionally to $\sqrt{t}$ after $t$ steps. Consequently, MuonGS guarantees $C_T=Ω(\sqrt{T})$, with accumulation sustained even in later training. Further, for smooth scale-invariant objectives we establish its $O(T^{-1/2})$ stationarity guarantee. In pretraining experiments with 160M- and 400M-parameter dense models as well as a 135M active- and 1B total- parameter MoE model, MuonGS achieves lower validation perplexity than MuonH at long training horizons. In particular, for the dense model it achieves an estimated token-equivalent speedup up to about $15\%$ at matched validation loss to MuonH.
articles.bodyZh: 权重衰减（weight decay）和显式的权重范数约束（explicit weight-norm constraints）能提升语言模型预训练（language model pretraining）里的优化器（optimizer）表现，但至于这种控制为什么有用、到底需要多少，目前还没有一个统一、完整的理解。我们用一个叫累计有效学习率（accumulated effective learning rate）的指标，来分析 Muon 在整个训练轨迹上的范数控制：$C_T=\sum_{t<T}\eta_t/\|W_t\|_F$。这里 $\eta_t$ 是名义学习率（nominal learning rate），而 $\eta_t/\|W_t\|_F$ 就是相对于权重范数（weight norm）的有效学习率。只要更新方向是有界的（bounded update directions），那么在任意训练区间里的这种累积，就能给相对权重位移（relative weight displacement）设上限。我们发现，原始版 Muon（vanilla Muon）只能按对数级别累积，这可能会限制探索，也有助于解释它为什么在实际训练里进展更慢；而 MuonW 和 MuonH 在给定条件下至少能保证线性累积。再往前走一步，不只盯着有界范数控制（bounded-norm control），我们还证明：只要范数增长足够慢，就能比最坏情况下的对数累积更快，这给限制更少的优化器设计打开了空间。基于这个观察，我们提出 MuonGS：它用格拉姆-施密特（Gram--Schmidt，GS）投影，把每次 Muon 更新里的径向分量（radial component）去掉，但又不把权重范数固定住。在更新方向有界、名义学习率恒定的情况下，我们证明：走完 $t$ 步后，权重范数最多按与 $\sqrt{t}$ 成正比的速度增长。因此，MuonGS 能保证 $C_T=\Omega(\sqrt{T})$，而且这种累积到了训练后段也能持续。进一步，对于光滑的尺度不变目标函数（smooth scale-invariant objectives），我们还建立了它的 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 平稳性保证（stationarity guarantee）。在预训练实验里，我们用了 1.6 亿和 4 亿参数的稠密模型（dense models），以及一个激活参数 1.35 亿、总参数 10 亿的混合专家（MoE）模型；在长训练周期下，MuonGS 的验证困惑度（validation perplexity）比 MuonH 更低。特别是对稠密模型来说，在验证损失和 MuonH 对齐时，估计能带来最高约 15% 的等效 token 加速（token-equivalent speedup）。
